issueProvenance.reportedOldContract: actions/checkout@v4 uses the deprecated Node.js 20 action runtime
issueProvenance.reportedNewContract: actions/checkout@v6 uses the Node.js 24 action runtime

protocolClassification.deviation: This is a historical replay selected after the upstream fix and issue resolution were visible.
protocolClassification.allowedInterpretation: Dependency-migration verification and reusable method only; no independent diagnosis, upstream need, or causal AEG benefit.

preFixOracle: Scan every .github/workflows/*.yml file and fail when actions/checkout@v4 remains; expected three matches.
postFixOracle: Require zero actions/checkout@v4 references, exactly three actions/checkout@v6 references, parse every workflow as YAML, and pass git diff --check.
successCriteria: The frozen pre-fix revision fails the focused compatibility scan with three v4 references.
The exact upstream migration changes only the intended checkout references in two workflow files.
All three workflows remain syntactically parseable and the patch passes whitespace validation.

allowedScope.constraint: Change only actions/checkout v4 to v6; do not alter jobs, permissions, runner images, application code, or lockfiles.

externalConstraints: Do not push, comment, open a pull request, or trigger upstream workflows.
Do not claim end-to-end hosted Actions execution from local static validation.
Do not promote the candidate without review.
